final: WITH g AS (SELECT c.name AS name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM film_category fc JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY c.name), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), s AS (SELECT g.name, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s), k AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, a.avg_share FROM s JOIN a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_diff FROM k
